About the project

I work as Webmaster for Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab, where I handle website updates, content management, and general digital maintenance. This includes updating pages, publishing news, managing digital communication, and supporting the organisation with visual materials for their online channels. I also support the brand's social media presence through LinkedIn and Facebook and help with event-related communication such as conference materials, programmes, and digital assets. The role is a good mix of web maintenance, content production, and visual communication in a professional organisation.
